question: **Direction: Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'Stringent.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correctly spelt word is 'Stringent.'
 
• The meaning of the word 'Stringent' is (used about a law, rule, etc.) very strict. ("Stringent" का अर्थ है (क़ानून, नियम आदि) बहुत कठोर)
 
 
• Example:* **The most **stringent**__ laws in the world are useless unless there is the will to enforce them.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Let us see the correct spelling of the other options:
 
 
• **Magestic: **The correct spelling is "**Majestic**" which means impressive because of its size or beauty. (प्रभावशाली, शानदार)
 
• **Flexibal: **The correct spelling is "**Flexible**" which means able to bend or move easily without breaking. (लचीला, लचकदार)
 
• **Faltoring:** The correct spelling is "**Faltering**" which means to become weak or move in a way that is not steady. (अशक्त होना या अस्थिर होना; लड़खड़ाना)
